name: National Assembly of Tanzania (Bunge)
notes: Elected constituency members, 115 women's special seats shared between parties by their vote, 5 from the Zanzibar House of Representatives, the Attorney General ex officio and up to 10 presidential nominees. No Seats chart. The Electoral Commission (INEC) listed 115 of 116 women's special seats on 7 November 2025 (CCM 113, CHAUMMA 2; one pending after postponed polls in Fuoni and Siha), but constituency results by party and the total could not be confirmed from an official page, so a chart would be partial. Also: the Bunge site gave no member list that could be read, and press and encyclopedia totals disagree (396, 403 and 'CCM 398'); party counts for the special seats were not found. The total is left blank until the Bunge publishes it. No supporter sits.
